parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method.

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go. This is the default value.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The billing method of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **Year**: annual subscription.
- **Month**: monthly subscription.

> This parameter is valid and required only when PayType is set to **Prepaid** (subscription).

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID. Set this parameter to the region where the subscription object resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region to which the change tracking instance belongs. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued.

parameters.name: SourceEndpoint.InstanceType
parameters.description:
数据订阅的实例类型，取值为：**MySQL**、**PolarDB**、**DRDS**、**Oracle**。
> 默认取值为：**MySQL**。

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The purchase duration of the subscription instance.

- If the billing method is set to **Year** (annual subscription), the valid values are **1 to 5**.
- If the billing method is set to **Month** (monthly subscription), the valid values are **1 to 60**.

> This parameter is valid and required only when PayType is set to **Prepaid** (subscription).
